title: Clashing Genres
subtitle: An opera house, a radio station, and the pulse of forgotten tunes.

trails.title: Medical Records
trails.description: We assure you that we strictly adhere to established medical standards.

content.text:
X/X, Wednesday

Charlie, 43, seasickness. Administered dimenhydrinate.

Janice, 29, severe seasickness. Administered dimenhydrinate.

Kalaea, 17, seasickness. Patient refused medication, advised to open a window and get some fresh air.

It's really trying how afraid some 17-year-olds can be of taking medication.

X/X, Thursday

Alessio, 33, diarrhea from consuming excessive seafood. Administered diphenoxylate, advised bed rest and adequate hydration.

Kalaea, 17, scalded by a water heater. Accompanying personnel were agitated and cursing; calmed them down, cleaned the burn, and applied ointment.

These two never cease to amaze me. Last time I spent ages explaining seasickness meds, and now they talk about 'water-fire boxes' and 'heat-pots.' Where on earth are they from?

X/X, Saturday

Received an emergency call from the crew informing me of an altercation involving five passengers in the dining area. Treated four with minor injuries and one with a light injury on the spot.

The captain tells me that it wasn't caused by those shell-wearing lads this time. Still, with their bizarre and smug demeanor towards others, it wouldn't surprise me if they got into trouble one of these days.

X/X, Tuesday

Eira, 22, bloating, diarrhea, vomiting, high fever. Administered IV fluids, kept under observation.

During observation, the patient showed signs of delirium, claiming the cruise had reached the 'New Era' and demanded to disembark and return to Nukutaeao. The shell on the patient's chest turned from white to red and developed numerous cracks. When questioned about this, the patient hastily hid the shell, and the accompanying person sternly rebuked us and changed the subject.

items.text: The air is buzzing with anticipation.
Regulus stands on stage, cheering and dancing in a lively twist.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hello, "Free Breeze"! Listen up all my rock 'n' roll stars, fans, and wannabes!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You lot are in luck, because you are about to experience the greatest, grandest, most radical rock 'n' roll party of the era!

items.speaker: Guests
items.text: Woo-hoo!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Now get up on those feet and drag those little legs of yours on deck. Because it's time to get those old bones jumping!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Just think, folks, one day you'll be sitting by a fireplace, telling your grandkiddies that you were here. This is the night you become a legend!

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Hi, Regulus!
Barcarola bursts into the room.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Well, if it isn't our star musician!

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: This isn't what we agreed on. I thought we'd make our preparations together.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Umm, what preparations?
Barcarola pats her chest as she tries to steady her breathing.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: To begin with, we must do a survey of our guests' musical preferences, then prepare a song list to match. Then we must carefully organize our transitions to optimize the flow of the concert.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wait, wait, wait!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Arrangements? Concert? What are you on about? This is rock 'n' roll, love! A proper rock 'n' roll party!

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: No arrangements? No song list? This isn't what I was taught to do in Cremona.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: As musicians, we have a responsibility to ensure that every listener enjoys an exquisite and seamless experience. We must allow them to savor the emotion and artistry of each piece!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Sounds a bit stuffy, doesn't it? C'mon, no reason to get all hung up on the details. Music is freedom! The only thing that matters in rock 'n' roll are the vibes!
Regulus clearly holds no space for unnecessary formalities.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You don't use your brain. You feel it in your heart, babe.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Guess your miserable old music teachers never taught you that, eh?
Barcarola furrows her brow, but eventually her expression relaxes.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Fine.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: But just to be clear, next time we do it my way.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ha! Cheers, love. You're an inspiration to musical directors the whole world over!
Flattery is often more effective than any incantation.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: You can find the record player in the locker backstage.
Regulus immediately darts backstage.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Fab!
Turn off the lights.
Connect the sound system, check the stylus, pick a record.
Position the tonearm, raise your hands high, and get ready for a—

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Is this what you call "heavy metal"?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Uh, what's that? No, no! First up is an iconic taste of psychedelic rock!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Uhh. But I haven't even found the power socket yet.
The clanging of metal echoes from the lower decks, growing louder and clearer.
Then, an eerie, otherworldly shrieking follows.
Followed by what feels like an earthquake.
While the guests exchange uneasy glances, Sonetto has sensed that something is amiss.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, those sounds are familiar, aren't they?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Metallic percussion sounds, sprinkled with screams of pain ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's Manus Vindictae!
Those blackened, bizarre metallic creatures rear their heads once more.

items.speaker: Disciple of the Manus
items.text: *roar* Sift ...
A torrent of metal instruments surges up from the stairwells to the lower levels, like oil gushing out of a pipe.

items.speaker: Disciple of the Manus
items.text: And ... trial ...! *roar*
The sudden commotion sends the guests into an uproar.
They huddle together, whispering nervously to one another.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What?! These persistent pests again?! Which hellhole did they crawl out of this time?!

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Don't worry, Ms. Regulus. I won't let them disturb your rock party!
She stands calmly but fiercely before them.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: You oafish barnacles are ruining the atmosphere and scaring our guests! I very much doubt you're doing this with the approval of Captain Grace.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: You should be working in the engine room, not making noise up on deck!

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Have you all forgotten the Seafarers' Code of Conduct?
They appear unmoved. The Foundation's investigators step forward, immediately taking command of the situation.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto, Regulus, get the crowd out of here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Get ready to engage with these Manus thugs.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Understood!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Barcarola, I'll ask you kindly to step back from these brutes.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Please, Miss. There's no need for alarm. I know they may look a little strange, but they're just engine crew. They work here.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: And as such, as our musical director, I have some authority over them. Moreover, it is my duty to ensure all our guests have a safe and enjoyable stay.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Now I see how the Manus kept themselves hidden.
Fatutu quickly finds herself trapped amid the restless crowd.
She stands on tiptoe, dazzled by the countless overlapping shadows and rays of sunlight.

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: Is that Barcarola? What's she doing over there?
Amid curious and astonished gazes, Barcarola gradually approaches the dark mass of Manus followers.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: If you've come to be entertained, or perhaps for some music lessons, I would be more than happy to assist you in the crew quarters later.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: However, your musical talents will not be needed at this time, as we already have a scheduled performance.

items.speaker: Disciple of the Manus
items.text: *roar* New ... era—
No heed is taken. Instead, a hammer is raised high.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Stop them!
More and more Manus disciples fill the perimeter of the hall, surrounding those inside like trembling penned sheep.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: W-What's happening!? Why are they acting crazy?
She stands resolutely, putting herself between the guests and the crazed Manus disciples, her heavy breathing condensing on the neck of her Crackling Box.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: As the musical director of the "Free Breeze," I can't allow you to harm our guests.
Hmph, enough of your nonsense, foolish outsider!
A flash of cold light streaks through the air.

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: No!

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: *Popo protect!
A shell-shaped ripple appears, deflecting the icy arrow.

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: Are you okay, Barcarola?
Fatutu darts out from the crowd, rushing over to Barcarola with no regard for the surprised stares of the Nukutai behind her.
What are you doing, Fatutu?!
That is an outsider! Have you forgotten your duty to your people?
A stern, familiar reprimand booms in her ears.
After steadying the shaken musician, Fatutu nervously turns around.
Her brother's figure looms in the shadows of the crowd. For the first time, this image deeply unsettles her.

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: No, never, but ...

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: Kamuta, this is not defending our home, and it doesn't feel like avenging it either.

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: What we suffered was not these people's fault! There has to be a better solution to all this!

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: This isn't our way. It isn't right.
Fatutu stares fearfully as her brother draws closer.
As he comes into the light, she finds herself staring into a face that is both familiar and strange.

items.speaker: Fatutu
items.text: Kamuta ...
Kamuta gently shakes his head. Inky black liquid drips from the seams of his mask.

items.speaker: Kamuta
items.text: Fatutu, we have no choice.
